findings.title: Essential actions are clipped outside the phone workspace
findings.change: Responsive redaction modes, keyboard area bounds, wrapping exports, and metadata content.

findings.title: Navigation takes too much space at the breakpoints that need it most
findings.change: Compact modal Tools menu below 1280px; workspace dominates tablet and phone layouts.

findings.title: The upload card stays oversized after selection
findings.change: Selected-file summaries use compact action rows and 64px phone thumbnails; redaction omits duplicate preview.

findings.title: The horizontal tab strip hides capabilities without explaining how to find them
findings.change: Labeled native tool selector exposes all available tools on constrained layouts; task headings identify the active operation.

findings.title: The landing page promotes project links before helping someone choose a task
findings.change: Search, popular task cards, and a complete available-tool directory lead the homepage.

findings.title: A successful download often leaves no visible result or useful comparison
findings.change: Persistent source-bound outputs include format, relevant details, size comparison, and Download again without processing again.

findings.title: Importing a video is presented as an operation the user has not started
findings.change: Video preparation and information reading are distinct from user-started processing.

findings.title: Trim starts in an invalid state and its presets can make that state worse
findings.change: Trim defaults to actual duration, clamps shortcuts, validates precise values, and offers labeled range controls.

findings.title: The merge uploader contradicts the batch task
findings.change: PDF picker allows multiple files; Add files appends; page counts and ordered files are explicit.

findings.title: Leaving a category silently discards a working edit
findings.change: Selections, settings, edits, and completed outputs survive route navigation in session memory; obsolete work is invalidated.

findings.title: Keyboard and assistive navigation carry avoidable friction
findings.change: Single interactive navigation links, named landmarks/controls, skip link, route focus, native dialog focus, and keyboard PDF reordering.

findings.title: Interactive controls are undersized for comfortable phone use
findings.change: Shared controls have comfortable minimum hit areas; mode buttons wrap and PDF actions remain visible.

findings.title: The default controls assume knowledge the target audience may not have
findings.change: Resize uses real dimensions and percentage presets; video uses named quality goals with technical settings in Advanced.

findings.title: Technical failure details are shown as the main explanation
findings.change: Office failures use plain recovery guidance, Choose another file, and collapsed technical details.

findings.title: Hashes are readable but unnecessarily difficult to reuse
findings.change: Copy individual or all checksums, announce copy feedback, and state positive/negative verification explicitly.

findings.title: The metadata screen offers irrelevant image guidance for a selected text file
findings.change: Metadata panels reflect file capabilities and explain the scope of supported image metadata removal.

findings.title: Unavailable tools have inconsistent affordances
findings.change: Unfinished PDF tools are absent from active navigation; direct URLs explain availability and link to Merge PDFs.

findings.title: Visual hierarchy is dominated by containers rather than the task
findings.change: Shared neutral surfaces, restrained borders, typography, blue primary actions, semantic dark-mode errors, reduced motion, and consistent states.

findings.title: File rows sacrifice the information needed to choose the right download
findings.change: Archive rows put complete wrapping filenames first, with size and a compact named download action below.

overall_design: Task-first homepage with everyday-language search and popular tasks.
Shared typography, spacing, neutral surfaces, semantic status colors, consistent controls, and reduced motion.
Desktop workspace columns; compact modal navigation and stacked controls on phones/tablets.
Compact selected-file summaries, workflow-specific editing controls, useful defaults, and Advanced settings.
Persistent source-bound results, re-download, size comparisons, and understandable recovery.
Session-memory work retention, explicit Clear/replacement, and stale async ownership guards.
manual_production_checks: Image: 350 × 208 PNG resized to 700 × 416; downloaded PNG header verified. Redaction area retained through Home → Back; phone export bounds x=33–342 within375px.

Video: preparation correctly labeled, real WebM compressed to MP4/H.264/AAC; 203313 bytes to124970 bytes (38.5% smaller); First30s on3s clip clamps end to3; invalid10s entry shows inline dark-mode validation.
PDF: native multi-picker selected two PDFs, page counts1+2, keyboard move-up reversed order, downloaded merged PDF verified as3pages.
Archive: two PDFs packed into ZIP, extracted, full filenames visible at390px, individual download works.
Utilities: Copy MD5 produces copied feedback, exact expected checksum produces Matches MD5, text-file metadata has no irrelevant removal action.
Office: damaged DOCX shows plain recovery; Choose another file opens picker; valid DOCX converts to a1pagePDF and Download again works without reconversion.
limits: Responsive checks use desktop browser viewports; physical iOS/Android touch, native pickers, safe areas, and soft keyboards still need real-device validation.
Qualitative design and selected keyboard/geometry checks are not a complete screen-reader or contrast audit.
